pinocchio.summary: Disney animated Pinocchio feature, released 1940; adapted from Collodi.

bambi.summary: Disney film dated 1942; based on Felix Salten, distinct from the book.

cruella.summary: Disney animated film dated 1961, featuring Cruella and adapted from Dodie Smith.

kiki.summary: Studio Ghibli lists its film adaptation with 1989 release and Eiko Kadono source credit.

howl.summary: Studio Ghibli lists its adaptation of Diana Wynne Jones with 2004 release.

arrietty.summary: Studio Ghibli lists its Mary Norton adaptation with 2010 release.

nausicaa.summary: Studio Ghibli catalogue lists the Miyazaki film with 1984 release.

shrek.summary: DreamWorks identifies Shrek as its 2001 animated feature.

oz.summary: Warner lists the 1939 live-action film, Judy Garland as Dorothy, and Baum source credit.

forrest.summary: Paramount lists the Tom Hanks film as a 1994 production.

miku.summary: Crypton describes a singing voice synthesizer and gives age 16. This does not establish that the character never plays an instrument.

ghibli_profile.summary: Studio Ghibli history places the studio in Tokyo since 1992, before the 2004 Howl film.

ahsoka.summary: Lucasfilm identifies her first appearance in The Clone Wars film; official film page dates it 2008.

clonewars.summary: Lucasfilm official release information for the 2008 animated film.

catwoman.summary: DC lists Catwoman first appearance as BATMAN #1 (1940).

kitty.summary: Sanrio identifies a girl designed in 1974, born near London, with piano-playing among her hobbies.
